name: admin.apps.approved.list
tokens: Live-verified 2026-09-20 with the enterprise-scoped xoxc: ok:true, real data returned matching the documented response shape. Important interpretive nuance: this only lists apps going through the org-wide Admin App Approval workflow (3 apps in the tested org), not "every app installed anywhere in the workspace" -- an app installed before that policy existed, or never routed through it, will not appear here even though it's actively installed. Don't use this as a general install-state check; see methods/admin-write-scope-2026-09.md.
purpose: List approved apps for an org or workspace.

limit.desc: The maximum number of items to return. Must be between 1 - 1000 both inclusive.

cursor.desc: Set cursor to next_cursor returned by the previous call to list items in the next page.

certified.desc: Limit the results to only include certified apps. When false, no certified apps will appear in the result.

safety_note_for_agents: This catalog documents Slack's UNDOCUMENTED/internal API surface for a specific workspace (Hack Club, Enterprise Grid). Calling an undocumented method with params_known=false means you would be guessing params against a real backend with unknown side effects -- do not do this against a real account/token without a human in the loop, and never call anything shaped like a write (*.delete, *.set, *.remove, *.create, *.update, and similar) without explicit human confirmation and a clear understanding of the blast radius, even when params_known=true. 'existence-only' verified does NOT mean 'safe to call' -- it only means the method name is real.
